display.purpose: H1 to H3, nav, path line, section labels, buttons, keycaps and inline code.

body.purpose: Paragraphs, lists, table cells and FAQ answers at a 70ch measure.

terminal.purpose: Code blocks and terminal chrome. Its Google Fonts subsets lack U+2500-25FF, so it never draws box borders.

capture.fontFamily: "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", "Liberation Mono", monospace
capture.purpose: The .tui text captures: a system stack that has box-drawing glyphs at its own letter advance, so columns align.

shadows.name: evidence-window
shadows.purpose: Separation for screenshot frames and terminal captures, and the terminal-styled demonstration panels. Light theme; the dark theme uses a black shadow at 0.6.

motion.name: mode-switch
motion.purpose: Opacity fade when the homepage mode switch changes panel. Off under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-priority action in a decision area.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A supporting action that stays visually subordinate.

components.name: Path Line
components.description: The restyled breadcrumb under the header. Segment text is the page's own crumb text.

components.name: Command Block
components.description: A prompt, one command and a copy button.
components.css: .ds-cmd{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:46px;padding:6px 6px 6px 16px;border:1px solid #e4dfeb;border-radius:9px;background:#ffffff}.ds-cmd b{font:600 14px "Geist Mono",ui-monospace,monospace;color:#15803d}.ds-cmd code{font:500 14px "Geist Mono",ui-monospace,monospace;color:#1b1524}.ds-cmd button{padding:5px 10px;border:1px solid #e4dfeb;border-radius:6px;background:#f3f0f7;color:#675d74;font:500 12px "Geist Mono",ui-monospace,monospace}

components.name: Keycap
components.description: A key binding, shown in both apps where both have one.

components.name: Terminal Capture
components.description: Real srelens-tui text in a dark frame, set in the grid stack so borders line up. Dark in both themes.
components.css: .ds-tui{margin:0;padding:16px 18px;overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid #2a2433;border-radius:10px;background:#100d16;color:#d9d3e3;box-shadow:0 24px 60px -24px rgba(20,10,40,.35);font:500 12.5px/1.5 "Cascadia Mono",Menlo,Consolas,"DejaVu Sans Mono","Liberation Mono",monospace}

narrative.overview: srelens is one product with one Rust core and two front ends, the desktop app and srelens-tui. The site is written as a shell session so both read as the same thing: monospace for headings, labels, commands and data, a proportional face for reading, a path for navigation, and real screenshots and terminal captures as evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Real desktop screenshots and srelens-tui text captures from v0.15.0 are the primary visual evidence.
Monospace carries the voice; Geist carries long reading.
Two complete themes that follow the OS; terminal surfaces are dark in both.
One warm accent phrase per page at most, on the H1 only.
Flat by default; shadows are reserved for evidence.
Every page is complete at rest, with no entrance animation.

rules.name: The Theme Rule
rules.body: The theme follows the OS, with a header toggle and a ?theme=light|dark override. Terminal surfaces stay dark in both themes.

rules.name: The Accent Rule
rules.body: At most one accent phrase per page, on the H1 only, four words or fewer.

rules.name: The Status Color Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red describe state. Brand violet carries links and primary action. Neither becomes ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Grid Font Rule
rules.body: Terminal captures use the system grid stack, not JetBrains Mono, whose Google Fonts subsets lack U+2500-25FF.

rules.name: The Evidence Elevation Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to screenshot frames and terminal captures. Marketing containers remain flat.

dos: Do lead with real evidence from the released version.
Do keep terminal and code surfaces dark in both themes.
Do take every color from a site.css token and keep body text at 4.5:1 in both themes.
Do keep each page complete and readable without JavaScript.
donts: Don't use gradients on text or backgrounds.
Don't add a second accent phrase, or one longer than four words.
Don't put shadows on marketing containers.
Don't invent benchmarks, customer logos, testimonials or adoption numbers.
